title: Using uvx in GitHub Actions in a cache-friendly way #Shorts
description:
If you use uvx in GitHub Actions, one environment variable is all it takes to stop re-downloading your tools on every run. Set UV_EXCLUDE_NEWER to a date, and uv resolves the same packages every time, making the cache actually stick. Add it to your next workflow and watch your build times drop.

#githubactions #pythondeveloper #uvpython #devtools #cicd #automation #softwaredevelopment #buildfaster #Shorts
